g.title: ID: task_source Responsibility: Provide the request and acceptance context. Owner: Operator or task system Runtime: Issue, ticket, chat, or manual request State variables: task_ref; acceptance_contract Invariants: Task intent is retained. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/workflow-model.md:1#Tabellio Workflow Model @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: tabellio_cli Responsibility: Orchestrate the Git-native agent workflow and evidence contracts. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js State variables: run_id; worktree; head_sha Invariants: Run state is bound to an exact repository and revision. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/workflow-model.md:1#Tabellio Workflow Model @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; implemented/source_code: scripts/capture-tabellio-context.mjs:1#context capture @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: git_store Responsibility: Store commits, refs, diffs, branches, and isolated worktrees. Owner: Repository operator Runtime: Git State variables: commit_sha; ref; worktree Invariants: Commit IDs are immutable. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/capture-tabellio-context.mjs:1#context capture @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: entire_source Responsibility: Provide checkpoint and session metadata for agent-assisted work. Owner: Entire Runtime: Entire CLI State variables: checkpoint_id; session_id; checkpoint_digest Invariants: Checkpoint identity is preserved. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/providers/entire-ledger-provider.mjs:1#EntireLedgerProvider @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: context_packet Responsibility: Bind task, actor, exact refs, changed files, and checkpoint metadata. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Versioned JSON State variables: base_sha; head_sha; merge_base_sha; context_digest Invariants: Integrity excludes the self-integrity field from its hash. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/workflow-model.md:1#Tabellio Workflow Model @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; implemented/source_code: scripts/capture-tabellio-context.mjs:1#context capture @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: evidence_store Responsibility: Record commands, checks, approvals, artifacts, and side-effect policy. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Versioned JSON State variables: run_id; head_sha; checks; approvals Invariants: Protected action classes default to deny. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/workflow-model.md:1#Tabellio Workflow Model @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: validation_worker Responsibility: Run committed validation manifests against an exact revision. Owner: Operator-managed worker Runtime: Node.js and repository tools State variables: validation_id; revision; decision Invariants: Validation is bound to the assessed commit and manifest. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/tabellio-validator.mjs:1#validation command @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/validation-runner.md:1#Validation runner @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: validation_ref Responsibility: Publish durable exact-head validation results. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Git ref State variables: commit_sha; manifest_digest; decision Invariants: Non-fast-forward or stale publication is rejected. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/tabellio-validator.mjs:1#validation command @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; implemented/source_code: scripts/lib/control-ref-transport.mjs:1#control-ref transport @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: git_spice Responsibility: Represent stacked branches and change-request relationships. Owner: Operator-managed tool Runtime: git-spice executable State variables: branch; parent; children; head_sha Invariants: Stack snapshots are tied to the current repository state. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/providers/git-spice-stack-manager.mjs:1#GitSpiceStackManager @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: github Responsibility: Store ordinary code and provide the pull-request review surface. Owner: GitHub Runtime: Hosted Git service State variables: pr_number; head_sha; checks; reviews Invariants: Code and review identity use repository and head identifiers. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/providers/github-provider.mjs:1#GitHubProvider @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/tooling-stack.md:1#Agentic Tooling Stack @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: review_command Responsibility: Import GitHub and agent feedback, retain triage, and evaluate readiness. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js State variables: review_id; pr_number; head_sha; readiness Invariants: Stale feedback remains visible and cannot authorize a new head. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/tabellio-review.mjs:1#review command @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/review-loop.md:1#review loop @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: review_ledger Responsibility: Store review feedback, findings, dispositions, fixes, and readiness state. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Git control ref State variables: review_cycle; finding_status; head_sha Invariants: Review state is independently verifiable. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/tabellio-review.mjs:1#review command @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/review-loop.md:1#review loop @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; implemented/source_code: scripts/lib/control-ref-transport.mjs:1#control-ref transport @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

text.tspan: Start run / task payload or CLI arguments
Resolve and manage repository state / Git CLI
Resolve checkpoint metadata / Entire CLI JSON
Publish validation result / Git ref update
Read or execute stack operation / git-spice CLI JSON
Read PR and review state / GitHub REST API
Resolve exact validation / Git ref read
Record feedback and readiness / Git control ref
